$notes: Schema is the richer one specified in the Arbiter integration brief.
Field 'verification' indicates how thoroughly each entry was checked in the session that produced this file:
- verified_this_session: endpoint shape was verified live or in current official docs.
- documented_endpoint:   endpoint is published in the provider's official docs but was not live-pinged here.
- confirmed_existence_only: portal is known to exist; the exact URL pattern below is best-effort and MUST be re-checked.
All entries below 'verified_this_session' MUST go through §9 (Registry Verification Protocol) of the Arbiter integration brief before being shipped.
Tier semantics: 1 = government / national statistical authority / canonical scholarly index. 2 = research consortium / academic infrastructure. 3 = NGO / community / volunteer-curated.
License field uses SPDX-style tags where unambiguous; 'varies' means dataset-by-dataset; 'unknown' means not documented at portal level.

$schema.name: human-readable name
$schema.type: API protocol family: CKAN | DKAN | Socrata | REST | SPARQL | SDMX | OAI-PMH | GeoJSON | WFS | DOC_INDEX | GITHUB | GraphQL
$schema.domains: topical tags used for FAE topic-to-portal matching
$schema.historical: true if portal serves time series / archival data
